grouping_limitation: GSE48684 cancer and normal-C equal title numbers are not donor pairs (sex discordance); normal-C excluded from training. Development specimen labels are unique, true donor identity unverified. External groups are conservative title-derived heuristic, not confirmed UUIDs.
source_preprocessing: GSE48684 submitted beta values previously SWAN normalized and ComBat adjusted across source study. Our train-only guarantees concern downstream steps only; original preprocessing was not refit within our CV. GSE68060 submitted GenomeStudio beta values.
probe_annotation_limitation: Only cg-prefixed shared probe IDs retained; no sex-chromosome, SNP-overlap or cross-reactive probe filtering; no gene annotation claim.
platform: Illumina HumanMethylation450 BeadChip; processed submitted beta matrices; no additional joint normalization or batch correction; no IDAT-level QC.
